scope: Review requirements, NOT an executable hint selector or proof. All rows assume earlier quick/proof-irrelevance/Nat/native phases have not settled the query. Future tests must observe the actual candidate helper/callbacks, not reimplement this table inside the checker.
priority_domain: UInt32-compatible rows mirror pinned upstream; larger regular heights specify the explicitly extended N policy only.

guard_cases.input: same resolved definition; both applications; equivalent levels; equal regular hints; arguments convertible
guard_cases.expect: congruence success, no body normalization

guard_cases.input: same guard; arguments nonconvertible; body erases them
guard_cases.expect: unfold both, do not return false

guard_cases.input: same guard; argument callback Decline OutOfFuel
guard_cases.expect: propagate Decline OutOfFuel, not Accept false and not fallback

guard_cases.input: same guard; argument callback Reject TypeMismatch
guard_cases.expect: propagate exact error, not cache a negative equality

guard_cases.input: same regular definition; full-arity universe lists inequivalent
guard_cases.expect: skip arguments and unfold both; do not immediately reject

guard_cases.input: same regular definition; levels_equiv runs out of fuel
guard_cases.expect: propagate exact Decline; do not interpret incomplete comparison as inequivalence

guard_cases.input: equal regular heights but distinct resolved heads
guard_cases.expect: no speculative argument callback; unfold both

guard_cases.input: same definition constants, not applications
guard_cases.expect: no argument congruence branch

guard_cases.input: same definition applications with abbrev hint
guard_cases.expect: no upstream speculative argument congruence; unfold both

guard_cases.input: same definition applications with opaque hint
guard_cases.expect: no upstream speculative argument congruence; unfold both

guard_cases.input: admitted theorem with body; any stored forged regular metadata
guard_cases.expect: delta eligible, effective opaque hint

guard_cases.input: admitted actual opaque declaration with body; forged abbrev metadata
guard_cases.expect: not delta eligible

guard_cases.input: validated definition classified DPrimitive; original abbrev hint
guard_cases.expect: retain abbrev; primitive identity/signature/body validation unchanged

guard_cases.input: unsafe/partial constant in safe checking view; any hint
guard_cases.expect: reject at typed use; hint cannot unwrap safety kind

guard_cases.input: unsafe definition in authorized unsafe checking view
guard_cases.expect: unwrap kind only there and preserve its stored definition hint

guard_cases.input: known definition but constant has wrong universe argument count
guard_cases.expect: ineligible selector; public checking still reports UniverseArity, not a valid opaque head

guard_cases.input: correct arity but undeclared universe parameter
guard_cases.expect: public checking preserves UnknownUniverse; selector eligibility is not a typing certificate

guard_cases.input: DDefinition without body in arbitrary raw environment
guard_cases.expect: retain malformed-input behavior, not successful equality by treating metadata as a certificate

guard_cases.input: same regular two-argument head; right argument callback errors; left would decline
guard_cases.expect: propagate right argument error; preserve upstream and current Rocq right-to-left speculative order

guard_cases.input: equal priority; left body normalization errors; right would decline
guard_cases.expect: preserve defined error ordering, not parallel or reordered callbacks

guard_cases.input: one delta head, other head a reducible projection application
guard_cases.expect: upstream retries opposite projection first; current priority-only patch does not claim to add this

guard_cases.input: same regular pair with prior failed congruence in upstream context-local failure cache
guard_cases.expect: upstream skips retry; stateless Rocq omission is a scheduling/fuel discrepancy

guard_cases.input: arbitrary env with duplicate name and different hints/bodies
guard_cases.expect: resolved newest declaration determines BOTH body and hint; never compare raw names from different resolve identities

guard_cases.input: high-priority erasing head applied to ill-typed argument in declaration body
guard_cases.expect: admission checks the argument even if conversion would erase it

fuel_contract: No old-strategy/new-strategy equality at the same fuel is asserted. Exact-result proofs compare indexed/cached/runtime methods against THIS new ordinary strategy for arbitrary inputs/fuel. Every Decline/Reject constructor and payload must be preserved by those refinements. These declarative strategy rows have NOT been executed against a candidate.
